Form

Forms are used for collecting user input. ZAKUIKit provides a comprehensive form system with layout options, validation states, and responsive behavior.

Basic Form

A standard vertical form layout with form groups containing labels and inputs.

Your full name as it appears on your ID.
HTML 
<form class="zak-form">
  <div class="zak-form-group">
    <label class="zak-form-label" for="name">Name</label>
    <input type="text" id="name" class="zak-input" placeholder="Enter your name">
    <span class="zak-form-text">Your full name as it appears on your ID.</span>
  </div>
  <div class="zak-form-group">
    <label class="zak-form-label" for="email">Email</label>
    <input type="email" id="email" class="zak-input" placeholder="Enter your email">
  </div>
  <div class="zak-form-group">
    <label class="zak-form-label" for="message">Message</label>
    <textarea id="message" class="zak-textarea" rows="3" placeholder="Write your message..."></textarea>
  </div>
  <div class="zak-form-group">
    <button type="submit" class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary">Submit</button>
    <button type="reset" class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline">Reset</button>
  </div>
</form>

Horizontal Form

Place labels and form controls on the same line using .zak-form-horizontal.

HTML 
<form class="zak-form zak-form-horizontal">
  <div class="zak-form-group">
    <label class="zak-form-label" for="name">Name</label>
    <input type="text" id="name" class="zak-input" placeholder="Enter your name">
  </div>
  <div class="zak-form-group">
    <label class="zak-form-label" for="email">Email</label>
    <input type="email" id="email" class="zak-input" placeholder="Enter your email">
  </div>
  <div class="zak-form-group">
    <div class="zak-form-label"></div>
    <button type="submit" class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary">Save</button>
  </div>
</form>

Inline Form

Display form controls in a single horizontal row with .zak-form-inline.

HTML 
<form class="zak-form zak-form-inline">
  <div class="zak-form-group">
    <label class="zak-form-label" for="email">Email</label>
    <input type="email" id="email" class="zak-input zak-input-sm" placeholder="you@example.com">
  </div>
  <div class="zak-form-group">
    <label class="zak-form-label" for="password">Password</label>
    <input type="password" id="password" class="zak-input zak-input-sm" placeholder="Password">
  </div>
  <div class="zak-form-group">
    <button type="submit" class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary zak-btn-sm">Sign in</button>
  </div>
</form>

Form with Validation

Use validation classes to indicate the state of form fields.

Looks good!
Please enter a valid email address.
Phone number seems incomplete.
HTML 
<div class="zak-form-group">
  <label class="zak-form-label" for="name">Name</label>
  <input type="text" id="name" class="zak-input zak-form-control-success" value="John Doe">
  <span class="zak-form-text zak-text-success">Looks good!</span>
</div>

<div class="zak-form-group">
  <label class="zak-form-label" for="email">Email</label>
  <input type="email" id="email" class="zak-input zak-form-control-danger" value="invalid-email">
  <span class="zak-form-text zak-text-danger">Please enter a valid email address.</span>
</div>

<div class="zak-form-group">
  <label class="zak-form-label" for="phone">Phone</label>
  <input type="tel" id="phone" class="zak-input zak-form-control-warning" value="123">
  <span class="zak-form-text zak-text-warning">Phone number seems incomplete.</span>
</div>

Form Spacing

Control the spacing between form groups using utility spacing classes.

HTML 
<form class="zak-form">
  <div class="zak-form-group" style="margin-bottom: 2rem;">
    <label class="zak-form-label" for="name">Name</label>
    <input type="text" id="name" class="zak-input" placeholder="Extra spacing">
  </div>
  <div class="zak-form-group" style="margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">
    <label class="zak-form-label" for="email">Email</label>
    <input type="email" id="email" class="zak-input" placeholder="Less spacing">
  </div>
</form>

CSS Classes Reference

Class Description
.zak-formBase form container
.zak-form-horizontalHorizontal layout
.zak-form-inlineInline layout
.zak-form-groupForm group wrapper
.zak-form-labelForm label
.zak-form-textHelp text below input
.zak-form-control-successSuccess validation state
.zak-form-control-dangerError validation state
.zak-form-control-warningWarning validation state

Accessibility

  • Always associate labels with inputs using the for attribute matching the input's id.
  • Use aria-required="true" for required fields.
  • Use aria-invalid="true" and aria-describedby to link error messages to inputs.
  • Ensure form controls are keyboard accessible and have visible focus states.
  • Use fieldset and legend for grouping related controls.
